prompt: The motion is: left hand positions, right hand fastens, push, release. I have done this since I was twenty six and I am forty nine now. I know exactly how long each hour is. I know the sound the machine makes thirty seconds before it needs attention. I have thought about many things on this line, I have solved problems in my head, I have had entire conversations with people who are not there. My supervisor says I am the most reliable worker on the floor. Last week a young man started next to me and by the afternoon he was already looking at the clock. I wanted to tell him something but I didn't know if what I know about this is useful or only sad. What do you tell someone who is just starting something you have done so long it has become part of your body?
